title: 第15章 小舅子？那也砍！
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
洪烈怔怔地盯着秦然。

    虎目中充斥着匪夷所思。

    心中那本已燃尽的热血，此刻竟又有了要涌现出来的趋势……

    青符站在一边看戏，袖中双手却是不自觉地摩挲了起来，眼中闪过一抹异色。

    秦然的误杀，让洪烈激动了，但唐梦辰却是彻底怒了。

    “云江仙！！”唐梦辰咬牙。

    秦然掏了掏耳朵，平静地看向唐梦辰。

    “你刚叫朕什么？”

    唐梦辰目光阴沉的盯着秦然，想到秦然当前的处境以及过往的窝囊相，他丝毫没将其放在眼中。

    “许典是本公子的人，本公子说了，不要杀他，你刚刚没听清楚？”

    秦然被逗笑了，“你的人？莫非…你才是大夏神朝真正的皇帝？”

    唐梦辰浑身一僵。

    但很快反应过来，嘴上依旧不留情。

    “云江仙，本公子是代姐姐来取东西的，你杀了许典，就是不给姐姐面子，你等着向姐姐解释吧！”

    秦然甩了甩手上血，缓缓抬起头，眼眸中没有了往日的讨好之色。

    他声调不高，却格外清晰。

    “朕是皇帝，你要向谁解释？”

    唐梦辰冷笑不止，“好一个皇帝！皇帝又如何，你还不明白自己当下的处境吗？”

    “哦？什么处境？不妨说来听听。”

    “哼，今日你若不给个交代，你就一辈子别想再碰我姐姐了。”

    “好，一言为定。”秦然痛快道。

    唐梦辰傻了。

    自己听错了吗？

    “云江仙！你！你…刚说什么？”

    秦然朝一旁的洪烈招招手，“刀疤脸，你叫什么来着？算了，不重要，过去给朕掌嘴，教教他怎么在朕面前说话！”

    “是，陛下！”洪烈应声抱拳。

    “你！你还敢打本公子？”唐梦辰满脸不可思议。

    他愤怒之时，眼前人影一闪，脸上已传来剧痛。

    洪烈毫不留情，一个个巴掌粗暴地甩在唐梦辰那张嫩脸上。

    啪！

    “第一掌，打你不敬帝王。”洪烈沉声喝道。

    唐梦辰被一巴掌扇懵了。

    啪！

    “第二掌，打你假传梦妃旨意，私闯皇家宝库。”

    这一掌，唐梦辰嘴角直接染血，脸也肿了起来。

    啪！
content_en:
Hong Lie stared at Qin Ran blankly.

The tiger's eyes were full of bewilderment.

The blood in my heart that has been burned out is now beginning to emerge again...

Qing Fu stood aside and watched the show, but his hands in his sleeves began to rub unconsciously, and a strange color flashed in his eyes.

Qin Ran's manslaughter made Hong Lie excited, but Tang Mengchen was completely angry.

"Yunjiang Immortal!!" Tang Mengchen gritted his teeth.

Qin Ran took out his ears and looked at Tang Mengchen calmly.

"What did you just call me?"

Tang Mengchen stared at Qin Ran with gloomy eyes. Thinking of Qin Ran's current situation and his past cowardice, he didn't take it seriously at all.

"Xu Dian belongs to me. I told you not to kill him. Didn't you hear clearly just now?"

Qin Ran was amused, "Your people? Could it be that... you are the real emperor of the Great Xia Dynasty?"

Tang Mengchen froze.

But he quickly reacted and was still merciless.

"Xian Yunjiang, this young master came to get something on behalf of my sister. You killed Xu Dian just because you didn't give your sister face. Just wait and explain to her!"

Qin Ran shook off the blood on his hands and slowly raised his head, his eyes no longer had the usual pleasing look.

His voice was not high-pitched, but extremely clear.

"I am the emperor, who are you going to explain to?"

Tang Mengchen sneered, "What an emperor! So what about the emperor? Don't you understand your current situation?"

"Oh? What's the situation? You might as well tell me."

"Hmph, if you don't give me an explanation today, you will never touch my sister again in your life."

"Okay, it's settled." Qin Ran said happily.

Tang Mengchen was dumbfounded.

Did you hear wrongly?

"Yunjiangxian! You! What...did you just say?"

Qin Ran waved to Hong Lie who was standing aside, "Scarface, what's your name? Forget it, it's not important. Go over and slap me and teach him how to speak in front of me!"

"Yes, Your Majesty!" Hong Lie responded and clasped his fists.

"You! You still dare to hit me?" Tang Mengchen looked in disbelief.

When he was angry, a figure flashed in front of him, and severe pain was felt on his face.

Hong Lie showed no mercy and slapped Tang Mengchen's tender face roughly one by one.

Snap!

"The first slap is for disrespecting the emperor." Hong Lie shouted in a deep voice.

Tang Mengchen was stunned by the slap.

Snap!

"The second slap is to punish you for pretending to convey Concubine Meng's will and breaking into the royal treasure house secretly."

With this palm strike, the corner of Tang Mengchen's mouth was stained with blood and his face became swollen.

Snap!
